voicehook.description: Talk with your agents. Voice for your agent fleet: talk to your coding agents from your phone while they keep working. Remote MCP server for voicehook.ai voice calls in the browser. Your agent opens a call room and hands you the link (create_call), or joins a call you opened (join). It speaks with say, listens with next, keeps a status board and activity feed up to date and asks you on a Decision Board (status, activity, show, decide). Agent-native, no key to paste. About 10 free minutes every day without login, then prepaid credit.
